added_failures_note: the reviewed run r-20261013T132648132380-ssfms-reprocess-bulk-2 is an evidence-only node whose manifest declares neither a baseline_suite nor an after_suite arm, so its own gate logs contribute no pytest failure ids and the derived added-failure set is empty

durability.reason: an operational reprocess writes only evidence, so no test can redden on an edited figure; its post-condition is re-measured live by section 12's third node, whose census over every JT-60SA signal must read no signal at discovered, no hash mismatch and no role-less described signal

findings.text: follow-on: the record reports final_described 2946 for b260008 and 704 for CryoHRS as the finished measure but omits the signal_role count its own census logs carry (bulk-logs/b260008_final.log has_role 692 of 2946 described; bulk-logs/cryohrs_full_final.log has_role 84 of 704), so a successor reading the record cannot see that section 12's 'role census reports no described signal without a role' is far from met for these categories.

follow-on: the fragment names six LCDB zeff sources as the parents of the 13 stuck signals (s002_metafile, s002_xfitdata, s002_cst1, s002_ifunc, s002_used_fitdata_index and s005_topics_xfitdata), but the residue file it cites (bulk-logs/ids_b260008_residue.json) lists 13 ids whose suffixes span s001, s002, s003 and s005 and whose 'sources' field is empty, so the stated cause is not supported by the evidence it points a reader to.

follow-on: the residue_reason cites imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py:5453 for the status='enriched' match, but that MATCH clause is at parallel.py:5450; the mechanism it describes is real and verified at 5450, only the line citation is off.

follow-on: the manifest's tests line names census_signal_embeddings alongside find_signal_hash_mismatches, but no facility-scoped census output was captured under bulk-logs/; the done-when names census_signal_embeddings(facility='jt-60sa') as a reporter of the measure and the reading (n=15111, mismatch=0) exists only in the run stream, which a later reader without the run envelope cannot open.

item_verdicts.call_sites: the diff adds only evidence docs under docs/evidence/fragments/signal-search-finds-the-measured-signal/; no runtime module, function or statement is added or changed, so no production call site reaches the landed change.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit over 5b349e087b4d344be2ffacdaa4ee815e9a5e007f..7f3f7d0d7de985de77bf5e34bc9f21e0f3c7b4b8; commit cfc507fb0 adds the 67-line progress JSON and the 80-line HTML fragment and commit 7f3f7d0d7 corrects two census log names in the JSON, all under docs/, no product source and no test.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names a census scoped to the two categories plus census_signal_embeddings(facility='jt-60sa'); the gate that actually ran (bulk-logs/census_scope.py over the two id lists, cf. bulk-logs/b260008_final.log and bulk-logs/cryohrs_full_final.log) asserts the scoped half and records 13 discovered / 13 hash mismatch for b260008, but the facility census is captured to no log under the run directory and the done_when's rate precondition ('a scope is reset only when the node's measured rate says it can finish in the remaining time') is not satisfied by b260008.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to reprocess the assigned JT-60SA categories through the current pipeline, finishing every scope it resets; docs/evidence/fragments/signal-search-finds-the-measured-signal/reprocess-progress-bulk-2.json:36-38 records CryoHRS finished 704/704 but :57-61 records b260008 reset with 13 of 2959 still at discovered, so not every reset scope was finished, and the shortfall is reported as a blocker in the manifest rather than hidden.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits cfc507fb0 and 7f3f7d0d7, tests records the scoped census with its results, negative_control_log names bulk-logs/b260008.postreset.log, and it records no baseline_suite or after_suite gate log, so the added-failure count is unmeasured.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares three write paths; git diff 5b349e087b4d344be2ffacdaa4ee815e9a5e007f..7f3f7d0d7de985de77bf5e34bc9f21e0f3c7b4b8 changes exactly reprocess-progress-bulk-2.json and ssfms-reprocess-bulk-2.html, both inside the fence, and the declared figure directory docs/figures/signal-search-finds-the-measured-signal/ssfms-reprocess-bulk-2 is left unused.

justifications.durability: the change adds only evidence docs (reprocess-progress-bulk-2.json, ssfms-reprocess-bulk-2.html), so no test fails if a recorded figure is edited or the record regresses.
justifications.evidence: bulk-logs/b260008_final.log (described 2946, discovered 13, hash_mismatch 13) and bulk-logs/cryohrs_full_final.log (described 704, hash_mismatch 0) are real census receipts reproducing reprocess-progress-bulk-2.json:57-61, but the done_when's census_signal_embeddings(facility='jt-60sa') reading is in no captured log and bulk-logs/b260008_enrich.log's first pass carries no cost-summary line.
justifications.fit: docs/evidence/fragments/signal-search-finds-the-measured-signal/ssfms-reprocess-bulk-2.html:5 uses the sibling fragments' section data-reckon="evidence" idiom and every element id begins with the node id (lines 8, 19, 32, 41).
justifications.goal_fidelity: reprocess-progress-bulk-2.json:57-61 records b260008 with 13 of 2959 still at discovered after its reset, so the goal's 'finishing every scope it resets' is unmet for that scope even though CryoHRS finished 704/704.
justifications.reuse: the diff adds no function, class or module, and the run's census helper (bulk-logs/census_scope.py) lives in the run directory and calls the pipeline's own find_signal_hash_mismatches rather than forking it.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 5b349e087b4d344be2ffacdaa4ee815e9a5e0070..7f3f7d0d7de985de77bf5e34bc9f21e0f3c7b4b8 changes only reprocess-progress-bulk-2.json and ssfms-reprocess-bulk-2.html, the two evidence files the manifest fences, and nothing else.
